title: DeathCoords
body:
# DeathCoords

Sends players their death coordinates.

## Features
- Lightweight and configurable.
- Server-side only.
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Purpur.

## Config (snippet)
```yml
message: "&eYou died at &f{x} {y} {z} &7({world})"
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
